title: Analyst lens: Sanofi vaccines in Taiwan

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: No item names nirsevimab or Beyfortus this week. RSV volume rose (29 vs 18 items), driven by a reported cluster of 16 infant infections within 20 days at a postpartum care centre linked to Changhua Christian Hospital. A single parent post reports paying out of pocket for a maternal RSV shot.
products.implication: Infant RSV protection is entering public conversation through outbreak news rather than product coverage, so questions from media, care centres and parents about infant options and cost may reach the company without a policy hook.
products.action: Prepare a factual issue-readiness pack on infant RSV burden and the regulatory and funding status of infant protection in Taiwan, and brief medical affairs on handling inbound questions from care centres and health bureaus without product promotion.
who: Postpartum care centre operators and associations
products.signal_zh: 本週無任何報導提及nirsevimab或Beyfortus。RSV聲量上升（29則對18則），主因是彰化基督教醫院相關產後護理之家傳出20天內16名嬰兒群聚感染。另有一則家長貼文表示自費接種孕婦RSV疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV保護是透過疫情新聞而非產品報導進入公共討論，因此媒體、產後護理之家及家長可能在缺乏政策切入點的情況下，向公司詢問嬰兒保護選項與費用。
products.action_zh: 準備嬰兒RSV疾病負擔及台灣嬰兒保護法規與經費現況的事實型議題應對資料包，並向醫學事務部門簡報，在不涉及產品推廣下回應產後護理之家與衛生局的詢問。
who_zh: 產後護理之家業者及公會

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: Doctors quoted by Rti, Life and 健康醫療網 link flu in older adults to stroke, disability and cardiovascular risk and mention adjuvanted or high-dose options. A veterans home in Hsinchu reports 84% uptake under the joint campaign with enhanced vaccine mentioned. High-dose volume eased to 11 items from 16.
products.implication: Clinician-led coverage keeps the enhanced category visible beyond long-term care, but funding is rarely stated, which can blur public eligibility and self-pay availability and create expectations among older adults outside facilities.
products.action: Prepare evidence summaries on flu burden in older adults for health bureaus and geriatric societies, track how enhanced-vaccine eligibility is described in coverage, and keep company-linked commentary strictly non-promotional given Taiwan's advertising rules.
who: Taiwan Association of Gerontology and Geriatrics
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費提供65歲以上長照機構住民
products.signal_zh: 央廣、Life生活網及健康醫療網引述醫師指長者感染流感與中風、失能及心血管風險相關，並提及佐劑型或高劑量選項。新竹一處榮譽國民之家在雙苗接種下接種率達84%，並提及加強型疫苗。高劑量疫苗聲量由16則降至11則。
products.implication_zh: 以臨床醫師為主的報導使加強型疫苗在長照機構以外持續曝光，但鮮少說明經費來源，可能混淆公費資格與自費供應，並使機構外長者產生期待。
products.action_zh: 為衛生局及老年醫學會準備長者流感疾病負擔的證據摘要，追蹤報導如何描述加強型疫苗接種資格，並鑑於台灣廣告法規，確保公司相關評論嚴守非推廣原則。
who_zh: 台灣老年學暨老年醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Very little this week: Tdap appeared in 7 items (5 the week before), and no recent coverage or social post discusses pertussis or Tdap specifically.
products.implication: There is no live issue to manage; Tdap is absent from the respiratory-season conversation dominated by flu and COVID-19.
products.action: Keep background monitoring and hold existing evidence materials on maternal and adult pertussis ready in case RSV or infant-protection stories widen to other maternal vaccines.
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週極少：Tdap出現於7則（前一週5則），近期無報導或社群貼文專門討論百日咳或Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 目前無需處理的議題；在流感與COVID-19主導的呼吸道季節討論中，Tdap未被提及。
products.action_zh: 維持背景監測，並備妥孕婦及成人百日咳既有證據資料，以防RSV或嬰兒保護報導延伸至其他孕婦疫苗。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced on October 13 that publicly funded Novavax will be offered from October 19 and that additional Novavax doses are planned. Multiple outlets carried the date, and Yahoo and LINE TODAY ran explainers on public eligibility for the rollout starting next week.
products.implication: The launch is official and widely covered, so first-week availability at clinics, eligibility clarity and any early experience reports will shape public perception of the brand within days.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC on supply and site readiness for October 19, prepare factual Q&A on eligibility and supply for media and health bureau enquiries, and set up close monitoring of post-launch social reports and safety questions.
products.signal_zh: 疾管署10月13日宣布公費Novavax將於10月19日起提供，並規劃增購Novavax。多家媒體報導此日期，Yahoo及LINE TODAY並刊出下週開打的公費接種資格說明。
products.implication_zh: 開打已正式宣布且廣受報導，首週診所供應情形、資格說明是否清楚及早期接種經驗分享，將在數日內形塑民眾對品牌的觀感。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署協調10月19日的供應及接種站準備，針對媒體與衛生局詢問準備資格與供應的事實型Q&A，並密切監測開打後的社群回報與安全性疑問。

issues.title: Novavax public rollout first week: site availability and eligibility questions
issues.note: The CDC date is fixed and widely reported; gaps between announced availability and clinic stock, or confusion over eligibility, would surface quickly in media and posts.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費開打首週：接種點供應與資格疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署日期已定且廣受報導；若公告供應與診所庫存有落差，或資格出現混淆，將迅速反映在媒體與貼文中。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu opening tests supply amid shortage fears
issues.note: Media already report people rushing over shortage fears while CDC orders more doses; a wider eligible pool could renew supply and enhanced-vaccine access questions.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感第二階段開打，在缺苗疑慮下考驗供應
issues.note_zh: 媒體已報導民眾因擔心缺苗而搶打，疾管署則追加採購；適用對象擴大可能再度引發供應及加強型疫苗取得問題。

issues.title: Infant RSV cluster coverage prompts questions on infant protection and cost
issues.note: The postpartum care centre cluster and parent posts on self-paid RSV shots could draw calls for public funding or care-centre requirements.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV群聚報導引發嬰兒保護與費用疑問
issues.note_zh: 產後護理之家群聚事件及家長自費RSV疫苗貼文，可能引發公費補助或產後護理之家規範的呼聲。

self_pay.title: Self-pay cost burden for older adults outside eligibility
self_pay.note: A Rotary club, reported by 自由時報 and LINE TODAY, calls for subsidies because self-paid vaccination weighs heavily on vulnerable older adults; this frames price as an access issue rather than a market one.
self_pay.title_zh: 不符資格長者的自費負擔
self_pay.note_zh: 自由時報及LINE TODAY報導，扶輪社因自費接種對弱勢長者造成沉重負擔而呼籲補助；此將價格定位為可近性議題而非市場議題。

self_pay.title: Maternal RSV paid out of pocket
self_pay.note: One pregnant poster reports paying for an RSV shot and being told the price would be higher after birth; this is a thin signal, and no item mentions self-pay infant antibodies.
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦發文表示自費接種RSV疫苗，並被告知產後價格會更高；此為微弱訊號，且無任何報導提及自費嬰兒抗體。

self_pay.title: Enhanced flu: clinician interest, no stock or price data
self_pay.note: Doctors in the media discuss adjuvanted and high-dose options for older adults without stating funding, but no item covers clinic stock, prices or self-pay demand for enhanced vaccines or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗：臨床醫師關注，但無庫存或價格資料
self_pay.note_zh: 媒體上的醫師討論適合長者的佐劑型與高劑量選項但未說明經費，且無任何報導涉及加強型疫苗或Tdap的診所庫存、價格或自費需求。

self_pay.title: Shortage fears may spill into private demand
self_pay.note: A news report describes people worried about shortages and rushing to vaccinate, without saying whether this affects self-pay clinic stock.
self_pay.title_zh: 缺苗疑慮可能外溢至自費需求
self_pay.note_zh: 一則新聞描述民眾擔心缺苗而搶打，但未說明是否影響自費診所庫存。
